name: COCO val2017 licence-filtered sample, 50 images
rule: val2017; licence in {4 BY 2.0, 5 BY-SA 2.0, 7 no known copyright restrictions, 8 US Government Work}; >=1 non-crowd box; 0 crowd boxes; no flickr-photo-id or (w,h,date_captured) match to train2017; first 50 by image id
annotation_licence: COCO annotations: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), COCO Consortium

training_overlap.note: val2017 is the upstream benchmark split (used to report box AP 42.7, possibly for model selection); screened against train2017 by image id, Flickr photo id and (width, height, date_captured), not by pixels

box_format: [class_index (0-79, COCO category order), x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels, non-crowd boxes from instances_val2017.json
